Accountant Job at Pruvia Integrated Limited




        
    

        
        Pruvia Integrated Limited, we are general service merchants with a strong desire to ensure customer satisfaction in the midst of efficient and effective service delivery. As an organization we are driven by the dictum of
‘Impossibility is Nothing’.

PIL was conceived in 2007, as regards to its incorporation and duly registered in 2013 with Corporate Affairs Commission of Nigeria (CAC) with Registration Number RC 1097861. It originated in response to providing world class services and solutions to the society at large and offering an alternative that is satisfactory in areas of our specialty. It has carried out service rendering duties in various states of Nigeria and within the ever bustling business environment of Lagos.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Off Osolo Way, Isolo - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and reliable Accountant with strong expertise in QuickBooks and Microsoft Excel.
	The ideal candidate must be financially disciplined, analytical, and capable of managing the company’s financial records, reporting, and compliance with accuracy and integrity.
	The role requires someone who can maintain financial transparency while supporting management with timely financial insights and reports.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage daily accounting operations and financial transactions.
	Maintain accurate financial records using QuickBooks.
	Prepare and analyze financial statements (Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow).
	Monitor income, expenses, and budget performance.
	Reconcile bank statements and company accounts regularly.
	Prepare accurate payroll schedules and ensure statutory compliance.
	Handle tax documentation and liaise with relevant regulatory bodies when required.
	Track receivables and payables to ensure proper cash flow management.
	Generate weekly and monthly financial reports for management review.
	Maintain proper documentation and filing of financial records.
	Support internal and external audit processes.


Requirements


	2–3 years of proven accounting experience.
	Proficiency in QuickBooks
	Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, financial reporting).
	Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial regulations.
	High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Trustworthy, discreet, and ethically sound.
	Excellent organizational and time management skills.
	Professional certification (ICAN, ACCA, or equivalent) is an added advantage.
	Applicants must live within proximity


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 Gross Monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Accountant" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Logistics Admin Officer Job at Pruvia Integrated Limited

PIL was conceived in 2007, as regards to its incorporation and duly registered in 2013 with Corporate Affairs Commission of Nigeria (CAC) with Registration Number RC 1097861. It originated in response to providing world class services and solutions to the society at large and offering an alternative that is satisfactory in areas of our specialty. It has carried out service rendering duties in various states of Nigeria and within the ever bustling business environment of Lagos.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Logistics Admin Officer

Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Gender: Male & Female

Key Responsibilities


	Supervise shipment examinations and oversee port operations.
	Prepare shipment assessments and all required documentation.
	Ensure accurate HS code classification and tariff compliance.
	Liaise with customs officers to ensure smooth and cost-effective cargo clearance.
	Process container deposit refunds.
	Monitor damaged or incomplete goods and take appropriate action.
	Ensure proper documentation, timely delivery, and adherence to workplace safety standards.
	Research item prices and functions using social media and online tools.
	Perform other duties as assigned.


Requirements


	B.Sc. / HND in a relevant field (minimum of a good grade)
	Strong computer proficiency
	Smart, intelligent, bold, and confident personality.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Logistic Admin Officer" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.
